pass2.sigma_formula: sigmas=linspace(1,1/N,N); mu=seq*m+b with m=(0.9-0.5)/(8192-256), seq=(H/16)*(W/16); sigma=e^mu/(e^mu+(1/sigma-1)); stretch so last=0.02; append 0 (scripts: sigmas_ref.py)
